candidates.change_summary: Replace the require check that prevents overflow with a stricter check that disallows any increase (prevents depositsCount from ever increasing).
Replace the require check with a condition that always fails, causing receive to revert and not increment depositsCount.
Replace the require check with a condition that always passes (true), behaving like removing the check and allowing depositsCount to increment normally even on potential overflow environments.
Replace the increment with a decrement so that calling receive decreases depositsCount, altering the observable state.
Replace the increment with assignment to zero so receive resets depositsCount instead of incrementing it.
Insert a second increment, making depositsCount increase by 2 on each receive call.
Delete the increment so depositsCount does not change when receive is called.
Replaced call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with direct transfer of entire balance to msg.sender, which changes reentrancy and gas/behavior semantics when withdrawAll() is called.

Removed the require check in onlyOwner modifier and replaced it with a conditional that silently returns early when msg.sender is not owner, changing permission failure behavior observable by withdrawAll().
Replace transfer with send (using return bool) and ignore failure (no require), which can leave funds in contract and change post-withdraw balance observable after withdraw completes.
Call withdraw target via low-level call sending value instead of transfer, which forwards all gas and may succeed/fail differently affecting final contract balance observed after withdraw.
Relax onlyOwner by allowing any caller (remove the require), changing which accounts can call withdraw and thus what balance is transferred when withdraw is invoked.
Replace the external call using low-level call with a transfer to the target, which will revert on failure and thus can change post-call state exposure.
Replace the external call with a call that forwards all gas and requires success, making failures revert instead of being ignored.
Insert an update to depositsCount after the call, changing observable state after sendMoney completes.
Replace the call with a no-op comment (delete the call), so no external value is sent and depositsCount remains unchanged compared to original.
Change onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (remove the require), altering which callers can invoke sendMoney and thus observable behavior tied to who can cause state changes.
